title: Cloud Database RDS Slow Query Spike

compliance.assurance_rationale: Saved search evidence for AU-2 when alert outputs are archived.

controlTest.negativeScenario: Replay benign `aws:rds:slowquery` traffic without `matching activity`. Confirm UC-4.12.3 returns zero rows and the alert does not fire.

description: UC-4.12.3 — Cloud Database RDS Slow Query Spike: queries AWS `aws:rds:slowquery` for configured audit predicates and returns actor, resource, and region context for performance review and change validation.
value: On AWS, detecting 'Cloud Database RDS Slow Query Spike' early shortens cloud incident response and produces defensible audit evidence for identity and change-management controls. UC-4.12.3 drives high-priority performance alerting before customer-impacting drift.

detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with search access to `index=aws`.
• Install and configure Cloud provider TA database inputs with the modular input for `aws:rds:slowquery`.
• Prerequisite crawl UC(s): UC-4.12.1.
• Confirm field extractions in `props.conf` for `host` and related actor fields.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Configure required cloud inputs per provider guide; index=aws sourcetype=aws:rds:slowquery.
Validate ingest before alerting:
```spl
index=aws sourcetype="aws:rds:slowquery" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=aws sourcetype="aws:rds:slowquery"
| table _time host db user query_time query
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.12.3_cloud_database_rds_slow_3"
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
Scopes `aws:rds:slowquery` in `index=aws` to detect cloud database rds slow query spike. Tune thresholds to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals and sandbox accounts via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare to the provider cloud console audit view for the same 24-hour window. Confirm row counts and `host` values match the vendor console. Run `| fieldsummary` on a 1-hour sample to verify extractions.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_12_3_alert` with severity aligned to `high` criticality. Dashboard: Dashboard panel, alert, and weekly compliance report..
Failure modes: (1) no events — verify modular input/API credentials and index routing; (2) empty actor fields — upgrade Cloud provider TA database inputs and review alias mappings; (3) API throttling — reduce poll frequency or enable queue buffering; (4) alert fatigue — tune thresholds and document exclusions in knownFalsePositives.
